description: RAG 召回可观测性面板 (W93 PR7 B-7) — 7 面板

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at) AS time, percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p50, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p95, percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p99 FROM search_logs WHERE created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND created_at < $__timeTo() AND source IS DISTINCT FROM 'system_metrics' AND latency_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at) AS time, AVG((per_path_latency_ms->>'vector')::float) AS vector_ms, AVG((per_path_latency_ms->>'bm25')::float) AS bm25_ms, AVG((per_path_latency_ms->>'graph')::float) AS graph_ms, AVG((per_path_latency_ms->>'rerank')::float) AS rerank_ms FROM search_logs WHERE created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND created_at < $__timeTo() AND source IS DISTINCT FROM 'system_metrics' AND per_path_latency_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at) AS time, AVG(candidate_k) AS avg_candidate_k, AVG(top_k_actual) AS avg_top_k FROM search_logs WHERE created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND created_at < $__timeTo() AND source IS DISTINCT FROM 'system_metrics' AND candidate_k IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(clicked_id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS ctr FROM search_logs WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND source NOT IN ('system_metrics', 'hybrid_retriever')

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN error_count > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 4) AS error_rate FROM search_logs WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND source IS DISTINCT FROM 'system_metrics' AND latency_ms IS NOT NULL

SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at) AS time, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE slow_query = 1) AS slow_count, COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM search_logs WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND source IS DISTINCT FROM 'system_metrics' AND latency_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 召回总量 + 错误 (24h 趋势)

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at) AS time, COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE error_count > 0) AS errors FROM search_logs WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND source IS DISTINCT FROM 'system_metrics' AND latency_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
